name: Photoelastic Fringes
desc: White light through a stressed birefringent specimen between crossed polarizers — an Airy stress function loaded by orbiting point loads throws isochromatic rainbow fringes that crowd into tight nested families around each stress concentration as the specimen is slowly loaded and relaxed over minutes, while black isoclinic bands sweep through wherever a principal axis lines up with the polarizer; also sodium-lamp monochromatic fringes, plane-polariscope isoclinics, a clinical FEA stress map, or luminous dark-field filaments.

energy.doc: brightness + colour gain of the fringes

scale.doc: magnification into a sub-region of the specimen — guaranteed visible change

speed.doc: rate the loads orbit and the stress field evolves (0.2 still creeps)

density.doc: number of point loads pressing on the specimen, 2 to 6 — each is a stress concentration with its own fringe family

load.doc: applied load — fringe order. Low = a few broad colour bands; high = dozens of tight nested fringes crowding the concentrations

polar.doc: polarizer angle — rotates where the black isoclinic bands fall (it also sweeps slowly on its own)

hue.doc: primary hue for the false-colour and dark-field styles (the isochromatic sequence is set by real R/G/B wavelengths)

x.doc: horizontal pan of the magnified region

y.doc: vertical pan of the magnified region

style.doc: aesthetic: white-light rainbow fringes / sodium-lamp dark-bright fringes / plane-polariscope isoclinic bands only / clinical FEA stress map / luminous dark-field filaments

seed.doc: deterministic seed for the load orbits and the stress field
